svg.title: Trump votes early as Obama returns to the campaign trail
svg.desc: Graphic poster illustration split diagonally between day and evening. Left: in Florida sunshine, Donald Trump, with swept blond hair, a navy suit, a red tie and a small voting sticker, stands with Melania Trump outside a low elections office while two reporters hold out microphones. Right: in a high-school gym with packed bleachers and a basketball hoop, Barack Obama speaks from a lectern to a cheering crowd.
